limits: One fixed-order known OD07 HIER pair; no general superiority or optimum claim.
Timeout counters are last authenticated samples, not final totals or final observer-health proof.
Nested operation and setup timers must not be added without disjoint-scope justification.
Skipped immediate finishes are not equal to avoided source-router runs: some would have used cached legs/labels.
